pattern: Rust modules by topic; the `#[wasm_bindgen] impl PageEngine` is split into several `#[wasm_bindgen] impl PageEngine` blocks, which wasm-bindgen allows, so the JavaScript class keeps every method
note: bind.rs keeps start, err, GpuHandle and its impl, the copy_in helpers, reader, typesetter, parse_edits, previews and the PageEngine struct, and adds `mod bind_page_doc; mod bind_page_pictures; mod bind_page_view; mod bind_worker; mod bind_text;` with `pub use bind_worker::WorkerEngine; pub use bind_text::{TextMeasure, Fixtures};`. The JavaScript names wasm-bindgen exports do not change, so `pkg/stage_web.js` and the canvas's imports stay as they are.
